question: How does the node #115 ObjectRegistry live and die: its control block, its 0xc0-byte layout, construction from the default library plus the global registrar map, AddLibrary registration, the singleton getter, the clone that links its parent to the singleton, the TTL registration, and the teardown order?

layout.note: begin +0x00, end +0x08, capacity +0x10; element {object +0x00, control block +0x08}
key-compare +0x30, RB header +0x38: color +0x38 = 0, parent/root +0x40, left +0x48 = &header, right +0x50 = &header, node_count +0x58 = 0 when empty
null in the singleton; the clone stores the singleton here
OPEN UNKNOWN: zeroed by the ctor and the clone, never read or written by any pinned routine, trivially destructible (dispose does not touch it); possibly a second mutex or plain data
zero-initialised (PTHREAD_MUTEX_INITIALIZER); locked by AddLibrary, the TTL registration and the big registry method 0x5ff88c0

registrar_node.map: global registrar unordered_map at 0x6509540; empty after static init (buckets = self+0x30, bucket_count 1, before_begin 0, element_count 0, max_load_factor 1.0, next_resize 0)

control_block.selector_note: byte at 0x64ed290: 0 selects `lock xadd`, nonzero selects a plain `addl` for every shared_ptr count update

slots.name: D1
slots.role: ret; the object is inside the block, so there is nothing to delete

slots.name: _M_dispose
slots.role: destroy the ObjectRegistry: release the parent shared_ptr, destroy the map tree, destroy the names vector, destroy the libraries vector

slots.name: _M_get_deleter
slots.role: return this+0x10 iff the argument typeinfo is _Sp_make_shared_tag; `*`-prefixed names return null; otherwise strcmp against the control-block typeinfo name

cb_d1.role: Control-block D1: endbr64; ret. The registry object lives inside the 0xd0 make-shared block, so deleting the object is a no-op.

cb_dispose.role: Control-block _M_dispose: (1) release the parent shared_ptr at +0x60 (fast path (1,1) inlines dispose+destroy; the slow last-use path calls 0x5d35070); (2) destroy the map tree rooted at +0x40 with the rec-destroy loop; (3) destroy the names vector at +0x18 (per-string heap free plus buffer free); (4) destroy the libraries vector at +0x00 (per-element shared_ptr release plus buffer free via a tail jump to _ZdlPvm).

cb_getdeleter.role: Control-block _M_get_deleter: return this+0x10 iff the argument typeinfo is _Sp_make_shared_tag (GOT 0x64ecdc8 -> 0x96cb48); `*`-prefixed names return null; otherwise strcmp the argument name against the string at 0x96c770.

rec_destroy.role: Recursive map-node destroy: recurse the right child (+0x18); release the weak_ptr at +0x48 (decrement cb+0x0c, if the old count was 1 call vtable slot 3 _M_destroy); destroy the string key at +0x20 (heap free via _ZdlPvm with capacity+1); operator delete(node, 0x50); loop to the left sibling (+0x10).

lockguard.role: lock_guard destructor {pthread_mutex_t*, bool owns}: if the stored pointer is non-null, pthread_mutex_unlock it, then clear owns.

vec_sp_destroy.role: Destroy a vector<shared_ptr> at its address (begin +0x00, end +0x08, capacity +0x10): release each element's control block with the (1,1) fast path or 0x5d35070, then free the buffer.

vec_insert.role: libstdc++ vector<shared_ptr>::_M_realloc_insert: 16-byte elements, growth doubling (minimum one element), copies 16 bytes from *rdx and bumps the copied control block's use count if non-null.

add_library.role: ObjectRegistry::AddLibrary(registry, name, creator): return -1 if the name is empty or the creator's manager is null. Append the name to the names vector (in-place SSO construction; grow via 0x5d655b0 when full). Allocate a new ObjectLibrary make-shared block 0x90 (control-block vtable 0x64d00f0, counts 0x100000001, mutex zeroed +0x10..0x38, map buckets = +0x68, bucket_count 1, max_load_factor 1.0, name = the argument via _M_assign). Lock registry+0x98, append the new library's shared_ptr to the libraries vector (direct store or _M_realloc_insert 0x5ff7960), unlock, then call the creator's invoker (vtable slot 3) with (creator, new library, name); __throw_bad_function_call if the creator is empty at that point. Release the temp shared_ptr afterwards.

reg_ctor.role: ObjectRegistry ctor(registry, default library shared_ptr): zero the fields, initialise the map header, seed libraries[0] with *default_lib_ptr via _M_realloc_insert, then iterate the global registrar map at 0x6509540 (before_begin first node; per node: name string at node+0x08, creator std::function at node+0x28; call AddLibrary; next = *node) until null.

reg_getter.role: ObjectRegistry singleton getter: function-local-static; guard byte 0x65090f8, holder at 0x6509100 (16 bytes {object, control block}); __cxa_guard_acquire/release; returns the shared_ptr BY VALUE via a hidden out-pointer in rdi (copies the holder's 16 bytes to (rdi), returns rdi in rax). Init path: operator new (0x10) holder, ObjectLibrary::Default 0x61f8b60, operator new(0xd0) block, install control-block vtable 0x64d8f00, counts 0x100000001, call the ctor with the Default return.

clone.role: ObjectRegistry clone: create a NEW registry whose +0x60 parent shared_ptr is the singleton (copy the getter's returned shared_ptr into the new object and bump its use count), otherwise zero-initialised like the ctor (map header, mutex). Takes the out shared_ptr in rdi, stores {new object, new block} there, returns rdi.

ttl_register.role: TTL registration: register a hardcoded "TTL" library into the singleton registry. Build a stack string "TTL", a stack std::function (functor 0x6208290, manager from GOT 0x64ee090, invoker from GOT 0x64ee088), create the library named "TTL", lock the singleton mutex +0x98, append ONLY to the libraries vector (NOT the names vector), unlock, invoke the creator with (new library, EMPTY string), release the temp, destroy the functor via manager op 3. The creator 0x6208290 is a large unpinned function (FDE 0x6208290..0x6208afa); it is cited by contract, not excerpted. Referenced by an lea at 0x6202df2 (function 0x6202da0, identity not pinned).

registrar_init.role: Static initializer: initialise the global registrar unordered_map at 0x6509540 (buckets = self+0x30, bucket_count 1, before_begin 0, element_count 0, max_load_factor 1.0, next_resize 0); construct the three build-info globals via 0x5f204e0 (git SHA, git tag, build date); register __cxa_atexit handlers for the globals 0x65095a0/0x65095c0/0x6509580.

lib_default.role: ObjectLibrary::Default (pinned in #3983): returns rax = the holder address 0x6509110 (pointer to the singleton shared_ptr), NOT the library object; 17 direct call sites.

ttl_creator.role: The TTL creator function invoked by the TTL registration with (new library, empty string); large function, not pinned here.

big_registry_method.role: Large registry method (0x1390 bytes) that calls the getter (0x5ff88fc) and vec-insert (0x5ff99d3), creates ObjectLibrary 0x90 blocks and PatternEntry objects, and locks the registry mutex at +0x98; not fully read and not excerpted. Identity still open.

release_helpers.0x5d35070: shared_ptr _M_release slow path (654 calls + 36 jumps binary-wide)

immediates.text: "default" is built from the immediates "defa" + "ult" (length 7), not a .rodata literal
"TTL" is built from the immediates "TT" + 'L' (length 3), not a .rodata literal

model.behaviour: getter -> ctor seeding -> AddLibrary register -> count/names/libraries -> clone parent link -> dispose order, map-node destroy, weak_ptr release, lock-guard unlock

open_unknowns: The 40 bytes at registry +0x70..0x98: zeroed by the ctor and the clone, never read or written by any pinned routine, trivially destructible. Possibly a second mutex or plain data; no pinned routine locks it.
The identity of the big registry method 0x5ff88c0..0x5ff9c50 (calls the getter and vec-insert, locks +0x98, builds PatternEntry objects): not fully read.
The TTL creator 0x6208290..0x6208afa: large function, cited by contract only.
The clone's caller at 0x60bb8f0 (function 0x60bb890..0x60bb932) and the TTL lea site at 0x6202df2 (function 0x6202da0..0x6202e78): identities not pinned.

Which (name, creator) pairs populate the global registrar map at 0x6509540 before the first getter call: the map is empty after static init 0x620b470, and the populating static initializers are not pinned.
